description: This file implements classes and helper functions for synchronization primitives (FenceNV11 and Sync11) using Direct3D 11 queries, including methods for setting, testing, finishing, and waiting on GPU fences and synchronization objects within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: FenceNV11
classes.description: A class implementing a Direct3D 11 fence for NVIDIA NV extension, managing query creation, testing, and finishing.

classes.name: Sync11
classes.description: A class implementing a Windows high-resolution timer based synchronization object for GPU command synchronization.

methods.name: FenceNV11::set
methods.description: Sets the fence condition using a helper function.

methods.name: FenceNV11::test
methods.description: Tests if the fence has been reached.

methods.name: FenceNV11::finish
methods.description: Blocks until the fence is signaled, polling repeatedly.

methods.name: Sync11::clientWait
methods.description: Waits for the sync object with a timeout, polling the GPU status.

methods.name: Sync11::serverWait
methods.description: Placeholder for server-side wait, currently a no-op.

methods.name: Sync11::getStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the sync object.
